categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches src/rpc/blockchain.cpp under RPC/REST/ZMQ label to fix input validation and concurrency handling in the dumptxoutset RPC.
categories.rationale: Prevents file corruption, prune-lock clobbering during concurrent runs, and wasted UTXO copying on stale targets. As noted in the description, requesting a rollback to a stale hash currently copies the full UTXO set and disconnects blocks before failing, while concurrent invocations clobber prune locks and write to the same file.
